english.title: Fail to give a person assistance / information / access in relation to use of CCTV in slaughterhouses
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without reasonable cause, failed to give to **(..SPECIFY NAME..), a person acting in the execution of the Mandatory Use of Closed Circuit Television in Slaughterhouses (England) Regulations 2018, without delay,

(A)_[assistance or information that the person may have reasonably required]_
(B)_[access to a CCTV system, installed to provide a complete and clear image of killing and related operations in all areas of the slaughterhouse where live animals were present, on request for the purposes of viewing images and information obtained by that system]_
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 10(b) and 12 of the Mandatory Use of Closed Circuit Television in Slaughterhouses (England) Regulations 2018.
